events.title: The Demo Finally Has Its Sound
events.summary: Hey all. First, an apology: until this update, the demo never played its music, and every sound effect was a placeholder beep. That's fixed, so turn it up. events.title: The Subway is Open
events.summary: Hey all. This is the biggest demo update we've done. The Subway is open, with its own Deep at the end of the line. Every run now fields its own roster of machines, and twelve of them are brand new. Elites can now take you down in one blow, and they show you exactly when it's coming. There's a CODEX, a paint shop, a map you can drive with a mouse, sixteen new cards and a long list of fixes. Grab a drink. events.title: Elites are back
events.summary: Another week, another demo update, and this one is a big one. Elites are back as a proper tier: sixteen new machines, each with a move of its own. The whole horde moves now too, with legs that walk and bodies that come apart when they die. Enemy attacks got clearer warnings, and anyone who joins a friend's game gets a round of fixes. events.title: Commanders Have Arrived
events.summary: Hey all. A week after the last demo update, here's another one. There's one big new thing in it, Horde Commanders, and a long list of fixes. A few of those fixes are for bugs in the last build that were honestly pretty significant, so if something felt off when you played it, there's a good chance it's sorted below.Horde CommandersThe horde has officers now. events.title: The City Plays Too
events.summary: This is a big one. Nothing in it is a new place to go — it's the same twenty minutes, and it looks and sounds like a different game.The city plays tooThe pitch has always been that the city is the enemy. Mechanically it wasn't; it was furniture. You levelled, drew three, took one and compounded, and the city answered by spawning more things.Now it drafts as well. events.title: There's a city under the city
events.summary: There's a city under the cityKill the PRIME Warden and the ground opens.THE GATE IS OPEN. Take it and you go down into the Interchange — a whole second act underneath District 1, with its own Warden, its own landmarks, and no way back up once you commit. There's a gatehouse on the way in: you get staged, healed and handed a draft before the door shuts, because what's down there does not care that you just killed a boss.Then you hold. events.title: Now In Your Language
events.summary: Now in your languageSCRAPSTORM plays in German, Spanish, French, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Japanese, Korean and Simplified Chinese, alongside English.Not just the menus — card text, help text, the results screen, and every achievement name and description. The game's own title travels too: in Chinese, Japanese and Korean it's 废铁风暴, スクラップストーム and 스크랩스톰.
